items.name: promo-pill
items.title: Promo pill
items.description: The “New: … →” announcement pill above a hero, filled from a card slot. In the page flow; never interrupts.
items.docs: Size: about 2 kB gzipped of its own, 65 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-sheet
items.title: Promo offer sheet
items.description: An edge tab that opens an offer sheet from its side (a bottom sheet on phones) with a revealable code and an apply link. Opens only when asked.
items.docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ (a base-* shadcn project) for the swipeable Drawer. Size: about 2 kB gzipped of its own, 100 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-progress
items.title: Promo progress
items.description: Progress towards a reward, such as free shipping. Standalone: pass the value, goal and reward.
items.docs: Size: about <1 kB gzipped of its own, 9 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-sticky-cta
items.title: Promo sticky CTA
items.description: A thumb-zone bar that appears once the element you watch (usually pricing) has scrolled away, and hides when it returns.
items.docs: Size: about 1 kB gzipped of its own, 23 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-carousel
items.title: Promo carousel
items.description: Every live card in a slot as a swipeable row with a peeking next card, so several campaigns share one place. Never auto-advances.
items.docs: Size: about 2 kB gzipped of its own, 70 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-showcase
items.title: Promo showcase
items.description: A feature showcase: one large frame and a row of chapters, each a clip that explains one thing. The bar fills while the clip plays and its end moves to the next chapter; hover, focus, a hidden tab or reduced motion hold it, and a failed or refused clip is timed like a still.
items.docs: Fill it from a card slot with <PromoShowcase slot="showcase" /> (each live card with media becomes a chapter; its eyebrow is the tab label), or pass chapters directly to <Showcase />. Media may carry silent clips (media.video). Size: about 3 kB gzipped of its own, 54 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-inbox
items.title: Promo inbox
items.description: A gift button with a count that lists every live offer on the page, one per campaign, including ones the visitor hid.
items.docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ (a base-* shadcn project) for the Popover. Size: about 2 kB gzipped of its own, 103 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-changelog
items.title: Changelog hub
items.description: A What's new trigger with an unread count and a panel of every live entry, newest first, with clips. Entries are card records in a slot; unread is per visitor and follows account stores.
items.docs: <PromoChangelog slot="changelog" /> in your header. Publish card records with slot 'changelog'; the eyebrow is the entry's date label (falls back to its start date). New labels clear when the visitor closes the panel. Size: about 2 kB gzipped of its own, 87 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promotion-kits
items.title: Promotion kits
items.description: Ready-made campaigns: storeSaleKit, productLaunchKit and courseEnrolmentKit, each with records in six languages and the provider settings they were designed for.
items.docs: Kits reference sample images under /promo-samples and /sample-pages; pass `images` with your own. Size: about 7 kB gzipped of its own, 7 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-spotlight
items.title: Promo spotlight
items.description: Points at one feature once: an anchored, non-modal popover with a soft halo on the element. Never takes focus; using the feature counts as a conversion.
items.docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ for the anchored Popover. Give the promotion `slot` the same value as the component's `name`. Size: about 2 kB gzipped of its own, 52 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-tour
items.title: Product tour
items.description: A few steps, each pointing at one thing on the page. Starts only when asked, resumes where the visitor left off, skips a missing target instead of stalling, and reports start, completion and skip like any campaign.
items.docs: <PromoTour id="welcome" steps={[{ target: '[data-tour="share"]', title, body }]} /> anywhere under the provider, and startTour('welcome') from a button. Pass { restart: true } to begin again. Size: about 2 kB gzipped of its own, 99 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-side-card
items.title: Promo side card
items.description: A “what’s on” card beside the page: docked in the free margin on wide screens, peeking from the edge elsewhere, with a pager when several campaigns run.
items.docs: Size: about 3 kB gzipped of its own, 69 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promotion-editor
items.title: Promotion editor
items.description: Create and review a promotion with a live preview of every placement, a preview clock, a plain-language schedule in an explicit time zone and taste warnings. Owns no data.
items.docs: Requires Base UI primitives (a base-* shadcn project): ToggleGroup and Slider use array values. Pass `timeZone` so dates are entered in the campaign's zone, not the reviewer's. Size: about 9 kB gzipped of its own, 97 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promotion-preview
items.title: Signed previews
items.description: Signed ?promo-preview links that show one draft to whoever holds them until they expire, silently (no events, dismissals or budget), plus a reviewer notice.
items.docs: Server: createPreviewToken(id, { secret }) for the link, verifyPreviewToken(searchParams[PREVIEW_PARAM], { secret }) on the page, then pass the loaded draft as <PromotionProvider preview={draft}>. Keep PROMO_PREVIEW_SECRET (32+ characters) server-side. Add <PromoPreviewNotice onExit={…} /> so reviewers know it is not live. Size: about 1 kB gzipped of its own, 10 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: campaign-timeline
items.title: Campaign timeline
items.description: Every promotion on one time axis: what is live, what is queued, where floating surfaces compete for the same days and routes, and what is still draft. Rows can select a record.
items.docs: Pass `timeZone` so ticks and schedules are labelled in the campaign's zone, not the reviewer's. Records competing for the one floating slot are flagged; a dialog wins over a spotlight, a spotlight over a toast. Size: about 2 kB gzipped of its own, 11 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: campaign-results
items.title: Campaign results
items.description: Exposures, click and conversion rates per arm with 95% Wilson intervals, and a plain verdict for each arm against control and for showing a campaign at all against its holdout. Never overstates: not enough data says so, with what is still needed.
items.docs: <CampaignResults events={events} promotions={records} />. Feed it the provider's events (collect onEvent, or read them back from your analytics). campaignStats(events) is the pure core, usable on a server over warehouse data. Size: about 3 kB gzipped of its own, 12 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promo-story
items.title: Promo story
items.description: Full-screen “what’s new” story for dialog records with presentation: story. Pass it to PromoDialog as story={PromoStory}. It only opens when the visitor asks.
items.docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ (a base-* shadcn project) for the Dialog. Render it through the free dialog: <PromoDialog story={PromoStory} />. Size: about 3 kB gzipped of its own, 89 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promotion-account-store
items.title: Account dismissal store
items.description: Dismissals that follow the signed-in visitor across devices, for dismiss.scope: account. Synchronous reads from a local copy, batched saves, and a fetch transport.
items.docs: Size: about 1 kB gzipped of its own, 1 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).

items.name: promotions-pro
items.title: Promotions Pro
items.description: Every pro add-on: pill, offer sheet, progress, sticky CTA, carousel, showcase, inbox, changelog hub, spotlight, tour, side card, story, campaign timeline and results, kits, editor, signed previews and the account store.
items.docs: Pro items install from the authenticated @kitsu-pro registry. Add it to components.json with your key in KITSU_PRO_KEY; see the Docs tab on the promotions exhibit. Size: about 1 kB gzipped of its own, 147 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).
